critical_bugs: interp1d and np.searchsorted require strictly increasing x-values; unsorted SLAM/MoCap timestamps (common in robotics due to network jitter) will trigger a ValueError crash.
Indexing [[0, -1]] on empty mocap_timestamps or slam_timestamps arrays causes an IndexError during the logging/sync quality calculation step.
warnings: scipy.interpolate.interp1d is deprecated in recent SciPy versions and may emit runtime warnings or break in future releases.
Wrapper function match_slam_to_mocap uses .get() with empty list defaults, bypassing shape assertions and risking silent downstream failures.
recommendations: Pre-sort timestamps and realign poses using np.argsort before interpolation to guarantee monotonicity.
Add early-exit guards for zero-length inputs (e.g., if len(mocap_timestamps) == 0: return np.empty((0, 3))) to prevent indexing crashes.
Replace interp1d with scipy.interpolate.PchipInterpolator or BarycentricInterpolator for modern compatibility and smoother angle handling.
Enforce strict type/shape validation in the wrapper instead of silent fallbacks, raising explicit exceptions on malformed dict inputs.
